expo.name: agentglass
expo._comment_userInterfaceStyle: automatic, not dark: this is what Appearance reports to the app, and pinning it to dark makes Settings' System mode a lie — measured in the emulator, `cmd uimode night no` left getColorScheme() answering dark for ever. The app still opens dark for anybody who has not chosen (see SHIPPED in src/theme.ts); this only stops the manifest from lying about the phone.

plugins.cameraPermission: agentglass uses the camera once, to scan the pairing code on your computer's screen.
